newsitem.title: USA: Sherwin-Williams backs $0.45 Q4 EPS estimate.
newsitem.headline: Sherwin-Williams backs $0.45 Q4 EPS estimate.

text.p: Sherwin-Williams Co said Friday it is "tracking toward" analysts' consensus earnings estimate of $0.45 a share in the fourth quarter compared with $0.39 a year ago, and towards a $2.65 mean estimate for 1996 versus $2.34 in 1995.

Asked in a telephone interview about First Call's estimate range of $0.39-$0.46 for the quarter, vice president of corporate development and planning Conway Ivy said, "We think we are certainly tracking within those estimates and toward the consensus estimate (of $0.45)."
He added, "That would take us to $2.65 for the year," which is First Call's consensus estimate.
Last month the Cleveland-based paint and coatings company reported third quarter earnings of $1.02 versus year-earlier $0.87, putting year-to-date earnings at $2.20 versus $1.95.
Ivy said the third quarter exceeded expectations, aided by good weather which helped paint sales.
Raw material costs remain relatively stable, he said.

Sherwin-Williams said earlier on Friday it plans to acquire stain, varnish and protective sealer maker Thompson Minwax Holding Corp for $830 million in cash from Forstmann Little & Co affiliates. It would be the largest acquisition ever for the Cleveland-based paint and coatings maker.
